algorithm: Augmented CRC over eleven bytes, 12-bit width, MSB-first, nonreflected, polynomial 0xC06; XOR final CRC value with decimal 42 (0x02A)
padding: 87-bit information word held in 11 bytes; CRC input starts with 75 payload+frame-type bits, followed by 13 zero padding bits to complete 88 bits; augmented CRC over 11 zero-padded bytes
crc_field: 12-bit MSB-first value occupying the last five bits of byte index 9 and first seven bits of byte index 10
init_reflection: Canonical augmented-CRC operation as specified by Boost boost::augmented_crc<12,0xC06>; nonreflected. Equivalent bitwise algorithms must be independently cross-tested. No separate init/xorout model proven.

provenance.note: Current main, not proven identical to installed v2.2.0 or v3.0.3

verification.comparison: Verifies physical codeword, not rendered JS8 heartbeat; K8IMT/K7YXZ hard tones do not pass parity/CRC; KD7WPQ missing
